title.narrative: Partnerships for equality: No to hate speech and divisive narratives in BiH

description.narrative:
Hate speech and other divisive narratives are symptomatic of the failure to constructively deal with the legacy of the 1992-1995 conflict.
The infrastructure to prevent hate speech is deficient, lacking synchronized legislation, clear capabilities among service providers, prosecutors, and investigators to apply it, as well as justice for both victims and perpetrators of hate speech. This is coupled with a lack of political will to address hate speech.
These gaps make it challenging to effectively identify, process, and prosecute such hate speech without infringing on free speech regulations. This situation calls for a strategic focus on enhancing institutional capacities and developing clear, actionable frameworks that enable law enforcement and judicial bodies to respond more effectively to hate speech incidents.
